# Own the Block v1.11.2

## Mascots and interface polish

- Redrawn mascots in the same bold-outline flat style: each one now has a body in the player's color, holds a gold coin, has soft cel shading, calmer eyes and its own accessory (capybara orange, panda leaf, rabbit bow, duck cap, cat tail and whiskers, elephant trunk and tusks).
- Fixed the broken white border around board mascots. The die-cut texture is now 512 px with mipmaps, a solid 14 px white border and a thin rim, so the outline stays continuous at board zoom.
- Tapping a mascot on the start screen makes it jump and throw a few coins. In the lobby the viewed mascot slides in from the side it came from, can be swiped to browse, and cheers when tapped or when a new mascot or color is confirmed. A seated mascot cheers once when its player becomes ready. On the board, pointing at or clicking a resting mascot makes it hop without changing tile hover or click behavior.
- Mascots do not react to hover and do not follow the pointer. Buttons get a light sheen and an icon nod on hover. Every new animation is one-shot, never loops and is off under the game or OS reduced-motion setting.
- The title is now just **OWN THE BLOCK**, without the "Phiên bản Việt Nam" / "Vietnam Edition" line.

## Gameplay and Power-up improvements since v1.11.1

- OB-7/OB-9: Power-up feedback stays readable without blocking play, and the approved rarity pool applies.
- OB-8: committed checkpoint movement facts make card and Power-up movement reconnect-safe.
- OB-11: purchase and build Power-ups can be used directly inside the purchase/development decision.
- OB-12: typed Power-up activity in the Journal.
- OB-13: reward Decline is on the left and Claim on the right, with Claim keeping primary focus.
- OB-14: Journal player names use each player's stable color.
- OB-15: completed Journal turns are published at each committed handoff.

## Compatibility and update

- Application version **1.11.2**. Socket protocol **18**. In-memory room snapshot schema **16**. Minimum supported version **1.11.2**.
- v1.11.1 uses protocol 16 and cannot play with v1.11.2. Desktop players must update both apps together. Strict handshakes reject mismatches with UPGRADE_REQUIRED. Browser guests use the client served by their host.
- Finish active matches before updating. The host keeps rooms and sessions only in RAM, so stopping or updating it ends its matches. There is no database migration.
- Windows publishes the Squirrel update feed. Unsigned macOS clients download and verify the DMG, then the user replaces the app manually.

## Validation and known limitations

The Owner explicitly asked for merge and production release of this version (OWNER-REPORTED). Local typecheck, lint, full tests, build and documentation validation passed. CI, release quality, all three distribution targets and packaged integrity proofs must pass before publication. Detailed evidence: project-document/releases/V1_11_2_RELEASE_VERIFICATION.md.

- Installers are **unsigned**, and macOS is **not notarized**.
- The new mascot animations were not watched at real frame rate in a foreground window. Their start/end states and unit tests were checked, and the manual motion checklist is still open. Physical GPU performance, independent devices or networks, real macOS use and an installed v1.11.1→v1.11.2 upgrade are **NOT RUN**.
